note.text: Real institution — Northeast Medical Group (NEMG) is Yale New Haven Health's physician foundation; the referring pediatric practice in this use case, running the Yale New Haven Health instance of Epic with Care Everywhere enabled. Individual clinicians (Dr. Laura Smith) are fictional. NPI shown is synthetic, not the real organization's actual NPI.

Real New Haven FQHC that accepts HUSKY and provides pediatric dental services; the receiving dental provider in this use case. Runs a dental PMS with an interim FHIR server. Individual clinicians (Dr. David Watson) are fictional. NPI shown is synthetic, not the real organization's actual NPI.

Real institution — Connie is Connecticut's state-designated statewide HIE (CGS Sec. 17b-59d/e), built as part of the state's Medicaid Enterprise System. In this use case Connie is the central routing hub: it routes the referral to BeneCare, routes the pre-encounter medical records from the Epic FHIR endpoint at Yale New Haven Health to the dental practice, and (at later interactions) routes the encounter summaries back to the medical care team. Named OHIA member organization (sector: State HIE).

Real — the HUSKY / Covered CT dental plan brand, administered by the BeneCare ASO under contract with Connecticut DSS. CTDHP handles the provider network, Plan-Net directory, referral coordination, member services, and prior-authorization / post-procedure review intake — it is NOT the claims payer. Dental claims (837D) are adjudicated and paid by Gainwell (the DSS fiscal agent). There is no dental MCO in the HUSKY model.

Real — the Administrative Services Organization (ASO) that administers CTDHP for Connecticut DSS (selected 2008). BeneCare facilitates administration: Plan-Net provider directory, referral receipt + coordination, prior-authorization / post-procedure review intake, and member services. It is NOT the claims payer and does not adjudicate 837D claims — those are adjudicated and paid by Gainwell (the DSS fiscal agent). The Plan-Net provider directory query in this use case is directed at the CTDHP/BeneCare network directory.

Real — the Connecticut DSS fiscal agent that runs the Medicaid Management Information System / CT Medical Assistance Program (CMAP, ctdssmap.com). Gainwell performs eligibility verification (270/271), DTR and PAS where prior authorization applies, and adjudicates and pays all dental claims (837D in, 835 out). It is the entity that actually administers the HUSKY plan operationally (claims/payment). There is no dental MCO in this model.

The HUSKY B (Connecticut CHIP) dental benefit. Administered by the BeneCare ASO (network, Plan-Net directory, referral coordination, PA/post-procedure review intake) on behalf of CTDHP; claims are adjudicated and paid by Gainwell (the DSS fiscal agent via CMAP), not by CTDHP/BeneCare — there is no dental MCO. Covers pediatric diagnostic/preventive services (e.g. D0150, D1330); periodontal scaling and root planing (D4341) is covered with medical-necessity documentation and is unusual for a pediatric patient; localized antimicrobial delivery (D4381) coverage is uncertain under the pediatric benefit (named open test finding). Connecticut Medicaid fee schedule rates apply. Prior authorization, where it applies, is evaluated at the treatment visit, not at referral.
